c8_method.ceiling_equation: unique positive root of (6498+1800*cos(3*pi/8+epsilon)^2)*(sqrt(10*epsilon)+epsilon)^2 - cos(3*pi/8+epsilon)^2 = 0 within 0<epsilon<pi/8
c8_method.completed_scope: Parameter optimization of the declared relaxed strict numerical sufficient-condition test only.

q7_boundary.model: R binary square; D[r,c]=R[r,c]*zeta^(r*c), zeta any primitive 35th root; either full Gram identity dI implies both.
q7_boundary.combined_with_inherited_qge11: No equality mask at N=5q for prime q>5 and integer q<d<2q.
q7_boundary.q7_rectangular_control: The retained 7-by-35 degree-eleven row Gram is valid and cannot extend to the required square mask. It does not contradict the square theorem.
q7_boundary.inherited_inverse_row_corollary: For prime q>5 and q<d<2q, Delta(5q,5q-d)>sqrt(d/(5q)); the inherited no-mask gap also yields Delta^2>=d/(5q)+1/[50*q*d^(4*q-5)].
